Arch-family box for the nvidia candy check plan. The arch base has no dnf, so the nvidia-container-toolkit gpgcheck probe must skip honestly rather than fail -- which is what charly check box nvidia-probe evaluates on the built image.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `nvidia`
